description: Read-only inspection of source values, formulas, and unverified stored formula caches from an .xlsx file without evaluating formulas or loading a resident session.

input_path.description: Path to the .xlsx file to inspect.

request.description: Inspect request object. Top-level keys are singular `selection` and optional `page` only (never `selections` or `sheets`).

selection.description: Either { kind: 'cells', addresses: ['Sheet1!A1'] } or { kind: 'range', address: 'Sheet1!A1:D20' }.

address.description: Finite sheet-qualified range when kind is 'range', e.g. 'Sheet1!A1:D20'.

addresses.description: Sheet-qualified addresses when kind is 'cells', e.g. ['Sheet1!A1', 'Sheet1!B2'].

name: inspect_xlsx
title: Inspect XLSX Cells & Cached Values
